statement.zh: Reisner《Mycerinus》(1931) 作为哈佛–波士顿美院联合远征的正式报告，公布吉萨第三金字塔（孟卡拉）金字塔庙、河谷庙与王后金字塔礼拜堂的发掘成果。
statement.en: Reisner’s Mycerinus (1931), the Harvard–MFA joint expedition’s final report, publishes excavation results for the Menkaure pyramid temple, valley temple, and queens’ pyramid chapels at Giza.
